game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Portability
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 3: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Portability.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Shadow Pit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Protect the ore lift from glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit: keep the digits meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: digits drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
